data.description: A thanadaemon can crush a soul gem (see caco&nl;daemon) as a standard action to gain fast healing 15 for 15 rounds (this is a standard action).  This action condemns the crushed sould to Abaddon - resurrecting this victim requires a DC 28 caster level check.
data.name: Soul Crush
